summary_1line: Yayati explains humility, destiny, and the loss of heavenly merit through vanity while recounting his long stay in celestial realms before falling from Nandana.

image_candidates.scene_text: A grim celestial messenger in the gardens of Nandana shouts 'Ruined! Ruined! Ruined!' as King Yayati begins to fall from the radiant paradise.
Yayati, glowing with celestial splendor, walks among fragrant flowering trees and dancing Apsaras in the lush gardens of Nandana.
As Yayati falls through the sky, grieving celestials watch from above while smoke from sacrificial fires rises from the sacred region below.
